q02.answer:
The Siti Hasmah Digital Library (SHDL) has the following operating hours:

*   **Trimester:**
    *   Mon–Fri: 9:00 AM – 10:00 PM
    *   Sat–Sun: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM
*   **Trimester Break:**
    *   Mon–Fri: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM
    *   Weekend: Closed
*   **Examination Week:**
    *   Daily: 9:00 AM – 12:00 AM
*   **Public Holidays:** Closed

The Law Library follows the same operating hours.

q03.answer: A student may be allowed to repeat a course up to a maximum of two (2) times.

q04.answer: Course withdrawal is permissible up to week seven (7) in a long trimester.

q05.answer:
The minimum passing mark for a subject is 40% (grade D) for all programmes in career Foundation, Diploma, and Bachelor (UGRD & UGDE).

This excludes programmes governed by professional bodies, such as:
*   Bachelor of Law (FOL)
*   Bachelor of Accounting (FOB and FOM)
*   Diploma in Accounting (FOB)

q06.answer: The convocation ceremony is normally held in November/December every year.

q07.answer: No, you cannot graduate if your CGPA is less than 2.00, even if you pass all your courses. The graduation requirement is a CGPA and GPA of 2.00. You would be required to repeat course(s) to increase your CGPA to at least 2.00.

q08.answer: For a non-engineering student who is under the "Not Following Programme Structure (NFPS)" category, the maximum number of credit hours that can be registered in a 14-lecture-week trimester is 20 CH.

q09.answer: To get First Class Honours in a Bachelor's Degree Programme, you need a CGPA of 3.67 – 4.00.

q10.answer: The graduation fee for a PhD Degree is RM 450.00.

q11.answer:
To be on the Dean's List, students must fulfil the following requirements:

*   **Foundation:**
    *   Minimum GPA: 3.67
    *   Minimum Total Credit Hours for graded subject: 12 (Long Trimester), 6 (Short Trimester)
*   **Bachelor/Diploma:**
    *   Minimum GPA: 3.50
    *   Minimum Total Credit Hours for graded subject: 12 (Long Trimester), 6 (Short Trimester)

q12.answer: No, students are only entitled to ONE MMU scholarship at any one time. Combining scholarships/financial aids from MMU is NOT allowed.

q13.answer: For the MMU PRESIDENT’S Scholarship, recipients must maintain a CGPA of 3.50 throughout their duration of study.

q14.answer: For enquiries regarding YUM Financial Assistance, you can contact them at 03-8312 5040/5043/5103 or email yum@mmu.edu.my.

q15.answer: MMU staff with 10 years or more of service are eligible for a 50% discount on programme fees for their children's studies.

q16.answer: The Examinations & Records Unit is open on Friday from 8:30 AM – 12:45 PM and 2:30 PM – 5:45 PM.

q17.answer: Labour Day in 2026 is on 1 May (Fri).

q18.answer: The Trimester Jul/Aug 2026 (Term 2620) begins on August 10, 2026.

q19.answer:

s3.answer:
Course withdrawal is permissible up to:
*   Week seven (7) for a long trimester
*   Week four (4) for a short trimester

You are allowed to withdraw from any course(s) you registered for, provided your academic load does not fall below the prescribed minimum load. A withdrawal will result in an automatic grade of "W" being recorded, which will not be used in the computation of your Grade Point Average (GPA) and Cumulative Grade Point Average (CGPA).

The current data does not provide the step-by-step procedure for how to withdraw from a subject. Please contact the Student Service Centre email ssc@mmu.edu.my for further assistance.

s4.answer:
Here is information regarding scholarships:

*   Scholarships, rebates, or discounts are not applicable to programmes that have already been discounted or are under a promotional package.
*   Students are required to comply with the Terms and Conditions in the Scholarship Agreement or the Letter of Award.
*   Late and incomplete application forms will not be considered for selection.
*   All scholarship applicants will be evaluated and shortlisted by the Scholarship Committee. Shortlisted students might be called for an interview.
*   Students are only entitled to ONE MMU scholarship at any one time. Combining scholarships/financial aids from MMU is NOT allowed.
*   Students may be awarded a sum that may be less than what is stipulated/published, depending on the availability of the Scholarship Fund.
*   The scholarship/tuition fee waiver and discount is not applicable for payment of re-sit/re-take of subjects.
*   Students are required to pay any fees incurred that are not covered by the Scholarship/Financial Aid.
*   MMU reserves the right to revoke any scholarship due to termination of student status, withdrawal, or change of the student's status.
*   Meeting the minimum eligibility criteria does not automatically guarantee a student a scholarship.
*   **Exception–MMU Merit Scholarship:** For the MMU Merit Scholarship, applicants who meet the minimum eligibility criteria and submit a complete application will be automatically awarded the scholarship, subject to the approved quota and availability of funds.
*   MMU Scholarships, Financial Aid, and Rebates are available through applications that can be submitted at: https://www.mmu.edu.my/financial-assistance/. They will not be considered without an application.
*   Students are required to provide information on the family’s financial position, as stated in the Scholarship Application form. MMU reserves the right to withdraw the Scholarship/Financial Aid application should the information furnished by the student be found to be false, misleading, or untrue.
